europe_now.title: EU heavyweights call to reignite frozen Russian asset debate
europe_now.summary: Leading EU figures are urging Brussels to revisit the discussion on utilizing frozen Russian assets to support Ukraine's reconstruction efforts. The push highlights ongoing divisions within the bloc on how to leverage these assets effectively.
